question: Jagoi and Cholom are the two main divisions of which of the following classical dance forms?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Manipuri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Manipuri** is one of the eight classical dance forms of India.
 
• It originates from the state of **Manipur** in northeastern India.
 
• The dance is deeply rooted in **Vaishnavism** and has a strong devotional aspect, often focusing on the **love story of Radha and Krishna**.
